text:
Maya R: VeraBio's AP emailed—saying their renewal invoice doubled the PLATFORM_FEE after private deployment renewal. They think we applied a new list-rate instead of honoring the renewal discount from the signed term sheet. Can someone pull the docs?
Ethan J: I'm on it. Invoice 2026-VB-8810 shows: 
```
Invoice 2026-VB-8810
Line 1: PRIVATE_COMMIT_MONTHLY   1 x USD 30,000
Line 2: PLATFORM_FEE_PRIVATE     1 x USD 15,000
Line 3: SUPPORT_TIER_ENTERPRISE  1 x USD 10,000
```
Customer contends platform fee should be USD 7,500 as per Renewal Addendum VB-RN-2026 signed 2026-02-05.
BillingBot: contract check: VB-CON-2024 + addendum VB-RN-2026 present. Billing rules applied: platform_fee rate = 15,000 (new price). Discrepancy detected. Opened ticket BILL-4689.
Kofi N: Looks like a price override in the addendum didn't propagate to the renewals job. Possibly a mapping miss for "renewal_discount_code" key.
Maya R: VeraBio says AP will withhold payment unless we issue corrected document. They also requested a statement showing applied credits for audit.
Priya S: Finance position: issue corrected proforma and credit memo. If they insist on immediate settlement to resume operations, consider partial refund for disputed amount, but prefer to net via credit.
LegalBot: Addendum VB-RN-2026 validated; effective on renewal date 2026-03-01. Legal approves corrected invoice.
Ethan J: Proposed correction: 
```
Corrected Invoice (proforma):
Line 1: PRIVATE_COMMIT_MONTHLY   1 x USD 30,000
Line 2: PLATFORM_FEE_PRIVATE (renewal discount) 1 x USD 7,500
Line 3: SUPPORT_TIER_ENTERPRISE (unchanged) 1 x USD 10,000
Adjustment: CREDIT MEMO CM-2026-VB-045 USD -7,500
```
Net adjustment = USD -7,500 credit to be applied to next invoice.
Kofi N: Please attach the signed addendum and the internal change request. Also mark ledger tag = "private-deploy-renewal-discount" so we can track refunds/credits vs normal credits.
Maya R: @VeraBio-AP: we'll issue a corrected proforma and a credit memo for USD 7,500. Will that unblock your payment hold?
VeraBio-AP (external): We need the corrected proforma and a separate statement for our auditors. If processed today we'll release the payment.
Priya S: Approvals needed: Finance + Rev Ops. I approve the proforma issuance. Priya S (Finance) 2026-03-22 10:05 PT.
Kofi N: Rev Ops approval: Kofi N 2026-03-22 10:12 PT. Accounting code for credit = 4-REV-PlatformCredits.
BillingBot: Proforma PRO-2026-VB-012 generated; credit memo CM-2026-VB-045 created. Ticket BILL-4689 status: RESOLVED-PROFORMA-ISSUED.
Ethan J: Sent proforma and statement PDF to VeraBio-AP; attached VB-RN-2026.
VeraBio-AP (external): Received—confirming we'll release payment once credit reconciles. Thanks.
Maya R: I'll update the renewal runbook to add a validation step for renewal_discount_code propagation. Kofi, can you create a post-issue ticket for engineering to add an automated assertion?
Kofi N: Will do. Opening ENG-BILL-1227 to add validation to the renewals pipeline.
BillingBot: BILL-4689 updated: RESOLUTION = "proforma issued + credit memo; pipeline validation created ENG-BILL-1227".
Maya R: Closing this thread.
